canonical_project: Microsoft Union City campus / Burr Computer Environments DRI
aliases: Microsoft Union City campus / Burr Computer Environments DRI

location.street_address: 4810 Stonewall Tell Road / Stonewall Tell Road # R
location.site_note: Official county records place Project Steamboat/EDCATL11 at 4810 Stonewall Tell Road or Stonewall Tell Road # R in Union City; Fulton sewer-easement exhibit also references land in the Cities of South Fulton and Union City.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-07-21. Official/local-government evidence now identifies Project Steamboat/EDCATL11 at Stonewall Tell Road, shows county approval of a sewer easement needed before land-disturbance permitting, and Union City's July 2026 public page states construction is underway on a Microsoft data center along Stonewall Tell Road. No certificate of occupancy, energization, partial-live, full-buildout, or utility interconnection approval record was located.
evidence_grade: B: official county/city sources confirm project identity, location, sewer-easement/land-disturbance prerequisite, and construction-underway status; capacity and some development-party details remain media/company-release reported.

actions.result_status: Approved a letter of inducement for Project Steamboat for up to $1.842 billion in taxable revenue bonds for a three-building hyperscale data-center campus at 4810 Stonewall Tell Road, Union City. Minutes state the expected development period would start in Q3 2024 and run through 2029 or 2030, and require all three phases to be completed by 2032.
actions.access_caveat: Economic-development approval; not a building permit, CO, or utility-service approval.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms Project Steamboat location, capital scale, three-building campus concept, development window, construction-job estimate, and 2032 phase-completion condition.

actions.result_status: Approved a 47,729-square-foot sewer easement dedication from EdgeconneX ATL11, LLC for the EDCATL11 Project at Stonewall Tell Road # R, Union City. The county staff text says new sewer-service connections require acknowledgment of county ownership interests before issuing a Land Disturbance Permit.
actions.access_caveat: The Legistar summary contains an apparent boilerplate error calling the EDCATL11 project residential; the title, owner/grantor, and attachment identify EdgeconneX ATL11 and the Stonewall Tell project.
actions.evidence_note: Official county infrastructure/easement action; supports pre-construction/site-work status, not energization.

actions.action_type: city council minutes / contextual status reference
actions.result_status: During hearings on separate TA Realty data-center rezonings near Red Oak/Buffington/Jonesboro, Union City staff stated there was currently one data center on Stonewall Tell.
actions.access_caveat: Contextual staff statement in minutes; not a project-specific permit record.
actions.evidence_note: Supports that the Stonewall Tell data-center project was treated by city staff as an existing/current project by late 2025.

actions.result_status: Union City's public news page says construction is underway on a Microsoft data center along Stonewall Tell Road and describes it as a more-than-2-million-square-foot, $1.8 billion project.
actions.access_caveat: City public-information article; not a CO, energization, or full-buildout record.
actions.evidence_note: Best current official/local-government evidence for moving status from local-process/approved-preconstruction to site work-construction.

capacity_mw_evidence.note: AJC reported a development-team news release giving 324 MW for the campus; official county/city records reviewed did not publish a MW capacity.

owner: EdgeconneX ATL11, LLC (county sewer-easement grantor); Microsoft reported/identified as end user by city and media sources

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.summary: Fulton County Legistar item 25-0016's summary/background text calls EDCATL11 a residential development, while the item title, owner/grantor, attachment title, and independent DAFC/Union City records identify EDCATL11/Project Steamboat as the Stonewall Tell data-center project.
contradictions.resolution: Treat 'residential development' as a likely boilerplate/carryover error; do not use it to classify the project.
